comment: Knowledge packs this build may download (only after the user agrees). manifest_sha256 pins the exact pack; experiments/pack_release.py writes an entry. The entries here are the published packs, so builds from any branch can download them; a release build replaces the file with its own catalog.

packs.name: lite
packs.title: Lite
packs.description: Lead sections of 400 000 Wikipedia articles, 150 000-entity fact bank, shelf index

packs.description: 1.5 million article leads, 1 million-entity fact bank, full shelf index – more answers, about 1 GB of memory
